Probe P6: a sheet with exactly 100 non-empty body lines and 105 non-empty manifest lines (3 frontmatter fields + 2 fences) passes with no ERROR. validate_craft_budget counts the whole file; a craft has no frontmatter, so its 'body' and 'file' coincide, which is why the two look alike and differ by exactly the frontmatter.

Reported as fidelity, not as an acceptance false; the coordinator may weigh it otherwise under rules/verification.md 10.
